rationale: Even after an informativeness PASS, observed system-level Spearman rho can retain differences in measurement geometry. Family identity could otherwise absorb systematic differences in tree size, taxonomy insertion, or the geometry-specific OU scale required to recover the fixed benchmark.

geometry_covariates.log_n_species: log(n_input_species) from final temporal informativeness result
geometry_covariates.prune_fraction: n_prune / n_input_species from final temporal informativeness result
geometry_covariates.log_calibration_lambda: log(S3 calibration lambda) from the outcome-blind known-truth informativeness gate

mandatory_sensitivity_model.scaling: center and divide by sample SD across the identical final crossed-core systems
mandatory_sensitivity_model.admitted_system_set: identical to primary model; no missing-covariate system may be silently dropped because every informativeness-PASS system must have finite n_input_species, n_prune and S3 lambda
mandatory_sensitivity_model.role: mandatory robustness check, not a replacement primary model

interpretation_rule: If the primary architecture label changes after geometry adjustment, report the primary result together with explicit geometry sensitivity and do not claim trait/family architecture is geometry-independent.
